name: Locator
description: Zooms from a whole country to one place, then a pin, the place name and a subtitle appear; full frame or a corner card.

controls.name: Map
controls.description: The map picture, drawn by tools/maps.py locator at three times the frame size.

controls.name: Place Position
controls.description: The place, in the map picture's pixels.

controls.name: Zoom
controls.description: How far to zoom in, from 1 (none) to 3 (the map picture's full detail).

controls.name: Corner Inset
controls.description: Play it all in a card in the top-right corner over transparency.

controls.name: Map Credit
controls.description: Shown in the map's bottom-right corner (empty for Natural Earth maps).

controls.name: Texture
controls.description: Optional paper or grain picture, multiplied over the map (white changes nothing).

controls.name: Badge
controls.description: Optional logo or flag in the card's top-left corner, fitted inside a 180-pixel square (empty: transparent).

controls.name: Name Font
controls.description: Any installed font, for the place name.

controls.name: Credit Font
controls.description: Any installed font, for the map credit.

credits: Natural Earth (public domain) for the maps
